summary: Keep st terminals serve-fabric from freezing Fabric while an attached terminal is idle

replay.detail: Only the serve-fabric tunnel copy changes; claim replay and shared projections are unchanged.

schema.detail: No schema, index or trigger changes.

rules.detail: Route proof, admission and authority are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The tunnel carries the same route line, answer and PTY session bytes; only the copy loop differs, a bounded read and write instead of std::io::copy's splice.

downtime.detail: Fabric runs st terminals serve-fabric per tunnel, so new tunnels use the new st after deploy with no restart.

recovery.detail: No new production state or recovery path.
